summary: Ziyad Jaber Alhdriti is a Software Engineering student at Umm Al-Qura University in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, with an expected graduation year of 2027 and a GPA of 3.73/4.00. His profile focuses on mobile application development, full-stack systems, clean architecture, structured software engineering practices, and AI-assisted rapid prototyping. His academic foundation includes object-oriented programming, data structures, database systems, software requirements engineering, UML modeling, software testing, SDLC, system design, and system integration. His main project is WASL, an integrated student transportation and accommodation platform developed with Flutter, Dart, Spring Boot, Java, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Git, and Agile Scrum. The project includes booking, service workflows, payment, rating, notifications, and admin management. His contributions include implementing mobile application screens from SRS and design documentation, integrating Flutter with Spring Boot REST APIs, contributing to booking and service workflows, and working with PostgreSQL through API integration. He also independently built a functional iOS mobile application in Swift in 2026, using local data storage and AI-assisted development to learn quickly and prototype the app. His certifications include Python 101 from Satr and a 30-hour Flutter Application Development Bootcamp from Hash Plus, where he built two mobile applications and practiced UI implementation, state management, API integration, and clean coding. He has completed more than 262 verified volunteering hours through the National Volunteering Platform in Saudi Arabia, contributing to digital outreach, charitable awareness, community support, coordination, and operational tasks. Listed skills include Java, Dart, Swift, Python, Flutter, Spring Boot, Git, GitHub, Firebase, PostgreSQL, SQL, REST API integration, mobile application development, UI development, Agile Scrum, SRS, UML, use case diagrams, sequence diagrams, ER diagrams, software architecture, requirements analysis, and software testing. Languages: Arabic native or full proficiency, English professional working proficiency.
